events.text: Spinning up an isolated centre plus simulator on spare ports so the probe doesn't disturb other lanes.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check sim port/state options and migration setup
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "sys.argv\|environ\|revops-vendor-sim.json" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8; grep -n "persist\|d1 migrations\|migrations apply" cloud/scripts/local-stack.sh app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs cloud/src/lane.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start isolated vendor simulator, find D1 name
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; rm -rf /tmp/t234v; mkdir -p /tmp/t234v; (SIM_PORT=8883 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t234v/sim.json SIM_PUBLIC=http://127.0.0.1:8883 nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t234v/sim.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t234v/sim.pid); npx wrangler d1 migrations apply --help 2>/dev/null | head -0; grep -n '"database_name"\|"binding": "DB"' wrangler.jsonc | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply migrations and start isolated centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t234v/state 2>&1 | tail -3; (nohup npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8961 --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to /tmp/t234v/state --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8883 --var READER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8883/reader/ --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8961 > /tmp/t234v/wr.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t234v/wr.pid); for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8961/ && break; sleep 2; done; curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run reminders probe against isolated stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8883 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t234v/probe.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -c ^PASS /tmp/t234v/probe.log; grep -c ^FAIL /tmp/t234v/probe.log; grep -v ^PASS /tmp/t234v/probe.log | head -15

events.text: Probe: 93 pass, 0 fail. Checking the key assertions, then stopping my servers.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm key probe lines, stop servers, check refusal list
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -iE "second|once|campaign ids|last import|calendar_url|join_day" /tmp/t234v/probe.log | head -10 | cut -c1-160; kill $(cat /tmp/t234v/wr.pid) $(cat /tmp/t234v/sim.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8961/; grep -n "growthclub.org\|gmail\|outlook\|usetantra" app/scripts/e2e-tantra-reminders-live.mjs | head -5 | cut -c1-200
